integrity: The pair census is reconstructed from the published Picard representatives and published Mordell-Weil permutation generators and replayed with exact integer arithmetic.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact statement for the 144 (-1)-curves of the index-2 Hesse-type Halphen surface; it does not settle the maximum for all extremal-Jacobian Halphen surfaces. The comparison with source Remark 6.13 concerns global divisor intersection number, not a largest local multiplicity at one point.
title: Intersection-four pairs among the 144 exceptional curves of the Chilean Halphen surface
